title: Rishab Shetty Wins Silver Peacock for Best Actor (Male) for ‘Kantara: A Legend - Chapter 1’ at 57th IFFI
subtitle: Jury recognises his complete physical and emotional immersion in the film, describing the performance as an experience that transcends acting
body_text:
Posted On: 28 NOV 2026 8:29PM by PIB Mumbai Release ID: 2343227 Views: 110 A A Print Share X Facebook Instagram WhatsApp Copy Article Link
Read in: English हिन्दी Marathi Gujarati Malayalam
Goa, 28 November 2026 Actor-filmmaker Rishab Shetty has been awarded the Silver Peacock for Best Actor (Male) for his performance in Kantara: A Legend - Chapter 1 at the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI). The award was presented by the Chief Minister of Goa, Shri Pramod Sawant, in the presence of Shri Chanchal Kumar, Secretary, Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, and IFFI Festival Director Shri Ashutosh Gowariker. Recognising the depth and intensity of Shetty’s performance, the international jury applauded his ability to take audiences through a compelling spectrum of emotions. Highlighting his complete physical immersion in the narrative, the jury observed, “ He laughs, he cries, he takes us into the journey of a spectrum of emotions. His entire body resonates with the film. He puts himself fully into the story. A breathtaking performance by Rishab Shetty that transcends acting and becomes an experience .” The Silver Peacock for Best Actor (Male) recognises an outstanding performance by a male actor in a feature film and the award comprises the Silver Peacock, a certificate and a cash prize of ₹15 lakh. Synopsis of Kantara: A Legend - Chapter 1 Set during the Kadamba era, the film follows events in the mystical forest of Kantara. After King Vijayendra of Bangra ventures into the forest and meets his demise, his heir, Rajashekara, seals the kingdom's borders. Years later, Berme, a forest native, crosses the forbidden boundary and discovers the kingdom's tyranny. When the ruthless prince Kulashekara attacks the forest tribes, Berme unites his people in a struggle for justice and dharma. The conflict unfolds into an epic clash of ideology, faith and destiny, determining the ultimate fate of two worlds. Rishab Shetty wins the Silver Peacock for Best Actor (Male) at #IFFI2026 for Kantara: A Legend Chapter 1! 🎉🎬
